name: Historic Centre of Telč
description: Telč is a small hilltop town in Czechia's Vysočina Region, ringed by fishponds that once helped defend it. After a fire in the late 14th century destroyed its wooden houses, the townspeople rebuilt in stone and added walls. Today you can wander its long central square and visit the castle, a Gothic stronghold remodelled in the late 15th century.
